collection_policy.audience_funnel: eligible impression/view -> engaged episode or run page -> decision interaction/inspection -> return visit
collection_policy.developer_funnel: docs visit -> attempted setup -> completed useful workflow -> repeat use or contribution
collection_policy.optional_fields: Only consented coarse session/cohort state; never email, private run ID, prompt, raw action, secret, save, full private referrer, or fingerprint.
collection_policy.retention: Retain aggregate experiment rows only for the stated window; delete raw event payloads and contact notes according to the approved operator policy.
collection_policy.absent_data: Display no observations; never display zero conversion when collection did not occur.

experiments.name: Experience-first versus architecture-first introduction
experiments.hypothesis: A plain outcome and evidence boundary before architecture will increase meaningful inspection among first-time spectators without reducing developer quickstart starts.

variants.A: Outcome-first: What actually happened plus pinned reports.
variants.B: Architecture-first: boundary diagram and source taxonomy before the outcome.

primary_metric.numerator: Eligible visitors who reach the evidence boundary and open a source pointer or evidence panel within the session.
primary_metric.denominator: Eligible visitors who receive the variant after bot, maintainer preview, duplicate reload, and missing-consent exclusions.
exclusion_rules: sessions without consent where consent is required

experiments.observation_window: 14 days after an approved variant is deployed
experiments.stop_rule: Stop after the first privacy incident, unsupported claim, or five qualitative reviewers report that the opening hides the evidence class; otherwise stop at the window end.
experiments.minimum_sample_or_qualitative_protocol: Prefer 100 eligible visitors per variant; if volume is lower, conduct five consented comprehension sessions and label inference as qualitative.
experiments.privacy: Use aggregate variant assignment; no cross-site identity or fingerprint. Store only public content ID and coarse timestamp.
experiments.attribution_limit: Cannot establish that ordering caused inspection behavior; report traffic and variant changes.

experiments.name: Outcome title versus question title
experiments.hypothesis: A concrete outcome-qualified title will earn more meaningful reading than a curiosity question while preserving accurate interpretation.

variants.A: What actually happened: two documented defeats
variants.B: How far can an AI climb? Read the report

primary_metric.numerator: Eligible title impressions followed by a source report open or evidence section completion.
primary_metric.denominator: Eligible impressions of the approved title variant.

experiments.observation_window: 14 days after the same report-only episode is approved
experiments.stop_rule: Stop immediately if either title is read as a verified win; otherwise stop at 14 days or after 200 eligible impressions per variant.
experiments.minimum_sample_or_qualitative_protocol: Target 200 eligible impressions per variant; with lower volume, conduct five comprehension checks per variant and record wording errors.
experiments.privacy: Aggregate content ID and variant only; no identity, full referrer, or raw query string.
experiments.attribution_limit: Title performance does not prove title caused completion or future return.

experiments.name: Report versus short-clip entry point
experiments.hypothesis: A short clip that immediately links to a pinned report will produce more evidence inspection per eligible start than a report card shown without a clip.
experiments.audience: Spectators discovering The Climb through approved channels

variants.A: Short clip with report link and evidence disclaimer
variants.B: Report-only card with same source link and disclaimer

primary_metric.numerator: Eligible entries that open the pinned source report or evidence panel within the observation window.
primary_metric.denominator: Eligible clip starts or report-card views, variant-specific, after bot/test exclusions.

experiments.observation_window: 21 days after both variants have the same source and destination availability
experiments.stop_rule: Stop if a clip implies an unapproved video or if the source destination changes; otherwise stop at the window end.
experiments.minimum_sample_or_qualitative_protocol: Target 75 eligible entries per variant; below that, review five sessions per variant for source-label comprehension.
confounders: device type if consented aggregate only
experiments.privacy: Do not export player IDs or raw referrers; use coarse event counts and consented cohort only.
experiments.attribution_limit: Entry source is directional; no person-level path or causal lift claim.

experiments.name: Decision card versus generic promotion image
experiments.hypothesis: A source-linked decision card will produce more evidence inspection and accurate recall than a generic promotional image, when the card is backed by a reviewed public manifest.
experiments.audience: Visitors with an approved public decision available

variants.A: Decision card showing observation, legal options, source, and outcome state
variants.B: Generic series promotion image with the same CTA

primary_metric.numerator: Eligible presentations of a reviewed decision card that include all required fields.
primary_metric.denominator: Eligible run-page entries where a reviewed public decision manifest is available.

experiments.observation_window: 14 days after a reviewed decision card and control are approved
experiments.stop_rule: Do not start without a reviewed manifest; stop on any missing field, private payload exposure, or claim that the local guess is a vote.
experiments.minimum_sample_or_qualitative_protocol: Target 50 eligible presentations per variant; otherwise run five comprehension sessions and inspect every reveal path.
experiments.privacy: Local guess is anonymous; collect aggregate event counts only. Never store selected option with a user identity or expose control endpoints.
experiments.attribution_limit: A reveal interaction measures inspection behavior, not decision quality or game impact.

experiments.name: Developer quickstart variant
experiments.hypothesis: A tested, narrow quickstart with prerequisites and evidence boundaries will increase completed useful workflows compared with a broad installation overview.

variants.A: Exact tested configuration, copy-paste command, expected output, and failure path
variants.B: Architecture overview followed by links to multiple repositories and optional paths

primary_metric.numerator: Server-side or otherwise verified completed useful workflow tied to the public content ID, not a button click.
primary_metric.denominator: Eligible quickstart attempts that pass the documented prerequisite and start signal, after bot/test exclusions.

experiments.observation_window: 28 days after the same source revision is deployed
experiments.stop_rule: Stop if success is inferred solely from a client click, requires hidden credentials, or exposes private host paths; otherwise stop at 28 days.
experiments.minimum_sample_or_qualitative_protocol: Target 30 eligible attempts per variant; below that, observe five consented setup sessions and record exact blockers.
experiments.privacy: No tokens, absolute private paths, IPs, or command transcripts in events; keep aggregate error category only.
experiments.attribution_limit: A completed workflow under one fixture does not establish broad compatibility or deployment readiness.

experiments.name: Creator-annotated versus unannotated analysis
experiments.hypothesis: A consented creator annotation will increase evidence inspection when commentary remains visibly separate from recorded facts.

variants.A: Source record plus approved creator commentary, uncertainty, and correction link

primary_metric.numerator: Eligible analysis readers who open the source record and evidence panel.
primary_metric.denominator: Eligible analysis entries assigned to the variant after consent and source availability checks.

experiments.observation_window: 21 days after creator consent, source review, and both variants are approved
experiments.stop_rule: Stop if commentary is mistaken for recorded fact, creator consent changes, or a correction/withdrawal request arrives; otherwise stop at the window end.
experiments.minimum_sample_or_qualitative_protocol: Target 50 entries per variant; otherwise conduct five comprehension sessions and one creator review before interpreting the result.
experiments.privacy: Record only aggregate content/variant events; never store creator contact details in analytics.
experiments.attribution_limit: Cannot claim annotation caused return or trust; the monthly coarse-cohort count is context only, not a return rate. Report observations and qualitative limitations.

experiments.name: Evidence source-link placement
experiments.hypothesis: A source link beside evidence claims will yield more source inspection than a footer-only link.

variants.A: Source record link beside the evidence state
variants.B: The same source record link in the page footer only

primary_metric.numerator: Eligible evidence_open events for the linked public source record in the assigned variant.
primary_metric.denominator: Eligible run_page_view events exposed to that variant under the same enrolled scope.

experiments.observation_window: 35 days after both source-link variants are approved and deployed
experiments.stop_rule: Stop if either placement hides a material evidence limitation or directs readers to private material; otherwise stop at 35 days.
experiments.minimum_sample_or_qualitative_protocol: Target 25 eligible evidence_open events per variant; below that, conduct five consented comprehension sessions per variant and report the small sample.
experiments.privacy: Use only public content IDs, coarse time and the approved evidence_open event. Do not put correction submissions, optional contact details, private links, or form text in analytics.
experiments.attribution_limit: An evidence_open event records source inspection, not a correction submission, a valid source pointer, trust, or comprehension.

repeat-engagement-proxy.numerator: distinct consented coarse cohort values with an eligible event
repeat-engagement-proxy.denominator: not defined as a person-level denominator
repeat-engagement-proxy.consent: Only granted-consent events with kind=consented_cohort and an eligible public content ID in the enrolled upstream scope.
repeat-engagement-proxy.scope: Use the separately labelled UTC calendar-month result and its completeness flag; do not relabel an experiment window as a complete month.
repeat-engagement-proxy.interpretation_limit: A count of distinct coarse cohort values, not people, returning visitors, repeat contributors, retention, or causal uplift.
